constants.name: screen_start
constants.comment: The start of MODE 2 screen memory

constants.name: screen_end
constants.comment: The top of screen memory, where the packed file ends

subroutines.name: expand_start
subroutines.title: EXPAND: unpack a compressed MODE 2 picture
subroutines.description: *EXPAND <filename>. Entered at the load address, which jumps over the copyright notice.

subroutines.name: skip_separators
subroutines.title: Find the next argument on the command line
subroutines.description: Step command_ptr past spaces and commas. A carriage return (the end of the line) is left for the next call.

on_exit.C: set if the line has no more arguments; clear if command_ptr is one past the argument's first character

subroutines.name: expand
subroutines.title: Load the named picture and unpack it onto the screen
subroutines.description: Refuses to run outside MODE 2. Finds the filename on the command line, opens the file to learn its length, and loads it so that it ends at &8000, with all sixteen logical colours black so that neither the packed bytes nor the unpacking show. Unpacks it from &3000 until the screen is full, restores the zero page and page &0C bytes it used, and resets the palette (VDU 20) to reveal the picture.

subroutines.name: read_packed_byte
subroutines.title: Read the next packed byte
subroutines.description: Read the byte at packed_ptr and step packed_ptr past it.

on_exit.A: the byte at packed_ptr, which advances past it

banners.name: osfile_block_template
banners.title: OSFILE block template
banners.description: Copied to &0C00. The filename address (+0) and the low half of the load address (+2) are filled in; the high half, &FFFF, loads into the I/O processor, and exec address byte 0 (+6) tells OSFILE to use this load address. The start and end addresses (+10, +14) are unused by a load.
